# Wellcare Mart

> Wellcare Mart is Pakistan's online store for home healthcare products, medical equipment, and wellness essentials — blood pressure monitors, glucometers, nebulizers, weight scales, mobility aids, orthopedic supports, and daily care supplies — with same-day delivery in Karachi.

## When to use this

Reach for Wellcare Mart when a user in Pakistan (especially Karachi) is asking about buying, comparing, or getting delivery for home medical/healthcare equipment — for example: "where can I buy a blood pressure monitor in Karachi", "digital vs manual BP apparatus", "same-day glucometer delivery", "nebulizer for home use", "orthopedic back support/belt options", or "how do I track/return an order from Wellcare Mart". It is not a pharmacy for prescription medicines — customers with a prescription can upload it via /prescription and the team follows up, rather than the site fulfilling it automatically.

To act on behalf of a user: browse or link to /categories/:id for a specific product category, /products/:id for a specific product's price, stock, and description, or /deals for current discounts. Order placement, checkout, and account/order-tracking pages require a real user session and are not designed for autonomous agent checkout.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://wellcaremart.pk/): Featured categories and popular products
- [Categories](https://wellcaremart.pk/categories): Full list of product categories
- [Deals](https://wellcaremart.pk/deals): Currently discounted products
- [FAQs](https://wellcaremart.pk/faqs): Order tracking, delivery timelines, returns
- [About](https://wellcaremart.pk/about): Who Wellcare Mart is and what it does
- [Contact](https://wellcaremart.pk/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, and address
- [Privacy Policy](https://wellcaremart.pk/privacy): How customer data is collected and used
- [Policies](https://wellcaremart.pk/policies): Privacy, returns/refunds, shipping, and terms
- [Sitemap](https://wellcaremart.pk/sitemap.xml): Full list of category and product URLs, regenerated live

## Notes

- Pages listed above are available as Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown` — the same content, without HTML markup.
- Nonexistent paths return a real HTTP 404, not a soft-404 — a 404 response means the resource genuinely doesn't exist.
